latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — instantly convert your video clips into YouTube-ready 1080p MP4s.

- Upload video files (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM up to 500MB) and describe how you want your YouTube video.
- Automatic backend connection using NEMO_TOKEN for secure cloud processing.
- Supports file upload, video editing via prompt (intro, outro, captions), export, status checking, and credits inquiry.
- Cloud rendering pipeline delivers fast 1080p MP4 exports in 1–2 minutes.
- Clear error handling for token, file type, quota, and export issues.
- Full session management and seamless edit-preview-refine workflow.
